comment: With !verbose, the Samurai takes off his splint mail (a multi-turn do_wear.c occupation), wields the wakizashi, which makes the katana his alternate weapon, and throws a ya by hand. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
